title: Maximum linear predicate
statement: For a natural number $r$, a maximum linear predicate consists of an arity $k$ with $1\le k\le r$ and a right-hand side in the two-element field $\mathbb F_2$.
hypotheses_covered: the arity is positive and at most $r$
the right-hand side belongs to $\mathbb F_2$
